slides.author: Alexey Grigorev
slides.title: FastAPI to Lambda for SSE
slides.subtitle: The agent logic stayed similar. The web adapter changed.

slides.title: What stayed similar
slides.body: The agent loop, search tool, renderer abstraction, and frontend remained close to the previous version.

slides.title: What changed
slides.body: FastAPI was removed. Lambda now receives raw requests and the handler routes method and path manually.

slides.title: Streaming matters
slides.body: A normal buffered response is not enough for an agent UI. The browser needs SSE events while the agent is working.

slides.title: The runtime choice
slides.body: The workshop used a custom Lambda runtime and Function URL response streaming to keep the UI interactive.
